notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 1527 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Be; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.611$ kcal/mol. 1560 K, melting point of Be; $\Delta H^{\circ}=2.919$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2500 K: $Cp^{0} = 12.598 + 1.500 \times 10^{-3} T - 4.369 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 12.598 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.750 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 4.369 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 5.288$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-1527 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -73.359 + 3.685 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.372 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 279.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -73.359 - 3.685 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} + 0.372 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 139.825 \text{T}^{-1} + 46.708 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1527-1560 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -71.775 + 0.726 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.590 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 402.750 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -71.775 - 0.726 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 0.590 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 201.375 \text{T}^{-1} + 25.421 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1560-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -75.724 + 1.386 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.590 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 402.750 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -75.724 - 1.386 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 0.590 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 201.375 \text{T}^{-1} + 32.805 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
2000-2500 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -74.699 + 0.803 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.700 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 193.100 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -74.699 - 0.803 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln \text{T} - 0.700 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 96.550 \text{T}^{-1} + 28.152 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K.
